messages:
matt: Quick proposal — add a small client-facing header to communicate retry hints and an opaque routing/debug tag for troubleshooting. Helps client retry logic and reduces support back-and-forth. Thoughts?

julia: what's the header name? don't want to leak internal routing identifiers to customers.

matt: initial sketch: `X-RI-Retry-Hint: soft|hard|no` and `X-RI-Debug-Tag: <8-char-opaque>`; optionally `X-RI-Decision-Code: UPSTREAM_OVERLOAD` for observability. keep payload tiny.

samir: fine, but no raw pool ids. we should emit pseudonymous tokens only (hashes) + a decision code enum. Eg `X-RI-Route-Tag: cacheable` not `pool-42`. Also TTL would help clients: `X-RI-Retry-TTL: 30` (seconds).

tara: from SRE perspective a short correlate id would be great: `X-RI-Debug-Tag` can be used to join edge logs -> backend traces. BUT it must be per-request and tenant-scoped so it cannot be used to stitch activity across customers.

julia: agree on two headers: `X-RI-Retry` (enum: no/soft/hard) + `X-RI-Debug-Tag` (opaque, 8 chars). docs should say "do not rely for correctness; hint only". Keep semantics tiny.

matt: example emission pseudocode: 
```
// decision path
emit_header("X-RI-Retry", decision.retryable ? "soft" : "no");
if (decision.debug_tag) emit_header("X-RI-Debug-Tag", decision.debug_tag);
if (decision.ttl) emit_header("X-RI-Retry-TTL", toString(decision.ttlSeconds));
```

samir: implementation notes: generate `debug_tag` as HMAC(tenant_id || request_id) truncated to 8 chars using rotation key. That keeps it opaque and tenant-bound. Also add rate-limit on header emission for noisy clients.

tara: telemetry: record `header_present` boolean and `retry_hint` value so we can quantify usefulness. Also track support tickets that mention the tag for correlation.

julia: one more ops-safety thing: version the contract header `X-RI-Contract: v1` so future changes are explicit.

matt: proposal: run a 2-week canary behind a feature flag on edge; measure percent of requests that get headers, distribution of retry hints, and whether debug-tag helped triage. I'll open a PR and feature flag. :memo:

ops-bot: deploy started for canary flag `edge-retryhint-v1` by matt — build 7821

tara: SGTM. Please add a short security review to confirm HMAC key rotation and non-linkability across tenants, and update privacy docs.

matt: will add the security checklist to the PR and drop a short how-to in the docs. thanks!
